parole.testo: Inherited from Late Latin -archa, from Latin -archēs, from Ancient Greek -άρχης (-árkhēs), from ἀρχή (arkhḗ, “rule, government”).

parole.significato: forms verbs from adjectives and nouns
parole.testo: Inherited from Late Latin -izāre. Doublet of -itzar, which was borrowed.
